name: netflix_narnia_trailer

source.title: NARNIA: THE MAGICIAN’S NEPHEW | Official Trailer | Netflix
source.note: source fields fixed by hand (title contains |)

cuts.method: cuts2.py adaptive detector (ratio 3.0, abs 0.25); black flashes folded by stats2.py; spot-checked by eye on verify pairs + sheet

beatsync: onsets/s 0.82 cuts on onset (+-0.1s) 20 % vs chance 16 %
empty_frame: mostly-empty 32% (on dark 31%, on light 0%), median empty share 54%
manual_corrections: Trimmed to 150.0 s (end screen). All 70 detected cuts confirmed by eye; added 10 soft cuts/fades (10.0,67.9,78.0,79.1,84.3,84.9,122.9,138.3,145.0,146.2). 42-46 s and 53-56 s are single shots with in-scene text reveals, not cuts. Beatsync after correction: 20 % on onsets vs 16 % chance.

manual.trim_reason: 150.0-160.6 s is the YouTube end screen (N + SUBSCRIBE)
manual.letterbox: 1.90:1 inside 16:9 (active ~854x448, bars 16 px = 3.3% H) - IMAX-style ratio, thinner bars than the two series trailers (2.00:1)
manual.corner_bug: none: no NETFLIX wordmark, no corner series title, no opening N sting (theatrical-release film trailer)

n_sting.where: only at the very end, after the date card
n_sting.look: prismatic N (white/violet/blue/orange light ribbons, not red) ~72% H on black, on the last music sustain; music fades -10 -> -59 dBFS from 147.5 to 149.25

text_cards.words: BASED ON THE BELOVED STORY FROM / C.S. LEWIS
text_cards.placement: centre over a wide shot (y 39-56%), in-scene, no plate
text_cards.style: off-white classical flared-serif caps (closest free: Cinzel Bold / Marcellus); fades up from black together with the picture
same serif; revealed letter by letter as the camera dollies past a dark foreground wardrobe edge (foreground wipe reveal)

text_cards.placement: inside a moving glass orb in the shot
text_cards.style: credit composited into a refracting glass sphere, Barbie script logo in white
white serif on blue nebula texture, dissolves (~0.5 s) into the next shot
two-size stack (small eyebrow + big line), cream serif caps on dark teal/blue nebula; hard cut in and out
franchise logo with a prismatic painted fill on the nebula texture; letters assemble within ~1 s of the cut at 139.83

text_cards.words: WRITTEN FOR THE SCREEN AND DIRECTED BY / GRETA GERWIG
ONLY IN THEATERS / FEBRUARY 12 / IN PREMIUM FORMATS + format logos
text_cards.style: same serif, format logo row (Dolby Cinema, HDR by Barco, 4DX, D-BOX)

manual.transitions: hard cuts; fades from/to black at 8.7-10.0 (black 1.3 s), 77.6-79.1, 84.1-84.9, 118.4-122.9 (4.5 s black); dissolve NEXT YEAR -> forest; morph stars -> sunrise lion 138.3; in-scene text reveals instead of cut-in cards in the first half

audio_events.open: very quiet 0-15 s (median -31 dBFS per 10 s) with short gaps to -42/-44 dBFS (5.0, 14.0-14.5 s)
audio_events.black_hold: 118.4-122.9 s black: level drops from -11 to -20/-30 dBFS but never silent; return at 123.25 s to -12
audio_events.end: no pre-title silence: music stays at -11 to -14 dBFS from 137.5 through title, credits and date, ends with a 2 s fade under the N (147.5-149.5)

timing_note: All times come from cut detection, cand.py/ffmpeg -ss frames or audio; strip-timed values are flagged. Contact-sheet tile k shows the frame at ~k+0.96 s.
